announcement.note: (Monday; WotC said so in the Oct 12, 2026 announcement)

estimates.why: P(act) ~50%: WotC's Oct 12 'very likely ... very hard look at the Eldrazi package' (~60%), +10 for the Eldrazi family at ~20% on MTGGoldfish (Eldrazi Ramp #1 at 12.0%) and Broodscale Bloodchief #1 on MTGTop8 (12%) and S-tier on Spellslinger (79 top 8s in 30 days, best conversion in the format), -20 for organic correction (Spellslinger: mono-green Broodscale share down from 11.1% to 4.8%, Broodscale Bloodchief tied with Rakdos Delirium at 6.8%; the Nov 19 and Nov 20 Challenges went to Cosmogoyf and Amulet Titan with one Broodscale deck in each top 8; effective archetypes steady near 31; no Modern RC until April 2027, so no season to protect; no new WotC wording as of Nov 21). Goldfish and Spellslinger still disagree on how big the deck is, so this is not averaged. x P(Command picked) ~30%: Basking Broodscale, Blade of the Bloodchief or Emrakul are the narrower enablers and Reddit now calls Broodscale 'the front runner'; the Command is a flexible 4-of in 19% of all Modern decks (#16 staple, also in Tron and Trudge decks), which WotC avoids hitting.
#39 Legacy staple in ~12% of decks; WotC called Legacy Eldrazi proactive and fair. No ban pressure.
Not a Vintage restriction candidate; in Commander it is in 0.78% of EDHREC decks and not on the Game Changers list (Scryfall: 53 Game Changers, Command not among them).

summary: WotC's Oct 12 update warned it is 'very likely that we take a very hard look at the Eldrazi package' if Eldrazi keeps sitting on top, and named Kozilek's Command as a bridge to Emrakul in Broodscale Combo. As of Nov 21 there is no new WotC word; the deck is still #1 on MTGGoldfish (Eldrazi Ramp 12.0%) and MTGTop8 (Broodscale Bloodchief 12%), but its share is slipping and every Challenge from Nov 16 to Nov 20 went to another deck, so a Nov 30 hit on the archetype is about a coin flip. If WotC acts, Basking Broodscale, Blade of the Bloodchief or Emrakul is the likelier pick; the Command is a real but secondary target.

sources.title: Modern Metagame (last 2 weeks)
sources.takeaway: 580 decks (last 2 weeks): Broodscale Bloodchief #1 at 12%, Rakdos Aggro 9%, UW Control 9%, Affinity 6%.

sources.title: Modern Metagame (full)
sources.takeaway: Eldrazi Ramp #1 at 12.0% (down from 12.5%); Eldrazi-family decks ~20% combined (Eldrazi Tron 3.6%, Eldrazi 2.5%, Broodscale 1.0%+0.3%, Mono-Green Eldrazi 0.3%).

sources.title: Modern Format Staples
sources.takeaway: Kozilek's Command #16 staple, 19% of decks; Sowing Mycospawn #29 (16%), Emrakul #33 (15%), Blade of the Bloodchief #48 (12%), Basking Broodscale #49 (12%).

sources.title: Legacy Format Staples
sources.takeaway: #39 Legacy staple, ~12% of decks: no Legacy ban pressure.

sources.title: r/ModernMagic: "Urza's Saga as a ban candidate"
sources.takeaway: 'Broodscale is the front runner for bans'; others in the thread float K-Command, Saga, Temple or Emrakul as indirect hits.
